**PotentialWax 1.4.0**

- **ROLL**: one tap for a random song played a random way. **MILD** puts the cues on phrases or bars, in the original key. **MEDIUM** may also cue on the hits, change what a pad plays, move to a new key and nudge the pitch. **WILD** picks any key, can switch to vinyl pitching and moves the pitch up to 5 semitones. TEMPO is left alone, so MATCH MPC keeps it in time. RANDOM TRACK still just picks a song.
- The DIG panel is rearranged to fit ROLL. Two parameters were added at the end of the list (Roll, Roll Wildness); saved projects open as before.

**Downloads**
- **`PotentialWax-1.4.0-akai-vst2.zip`**: for **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, any standalone MPC (32-bit and 64-bit). Turn on **External Plugin Support** in Preferences → Enhancements (Beta), unzip, and copy the folder into **VST2 Plugins** at the top of a drive. See the [install guide](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialwax/blob/main/INSTALL-GUIDE.md).
- **`PotentialWax-1.4.0-mpc-sdk.zip`**: the same plugin folder in the Open MPC catalog's 3.10.1 format (one folder for every MPC).
- **`PotentialWax-1.4.0-mpc-armv7.zip`**: for Gen1 MPCs with the community plugin set-up on older MPC OS 3.x. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.
- **`PotentialWax-1.4.0-mpc-aarch64.zip`**: the same for Gen2 MPCs (MPC Live III, XL), installed by the Open MPC Plugin Manager.

Install it one way only. Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome: [open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialwax/issues/new/choose).
